subject: Pre-demo preflight: use case, concurrency, and trial access
messages:
From: Sara Nadeem <sara.nadeem@parcelly.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in Redwood trial + quick demo

Hi Markus,

We signed up on the self-serve flow last week (Parcelly). I was routed to the SDR queue and wanted to see whether we can get a quick walkthrough before we start the pilot. High level: we want to use embeddings + chat for a customer support augmentation use case (ticket summarization and suggested responses).

Quick context:
- Team: 3 product engineers, 1 ML engineer (pilot).
- Goal: reduce average handle time and help CS triage.
- Timing: hoping to start a 4–6 week pilot in November.

Can we do a 20–30m demo this week or early next week? I attached a small traffic snapshot to give you an idea of volume.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Nadeem
Head of Product, Parcelly
[sara.nadeem@parcelly.com]
[Attachment: Parcelly_Traffic_Snapshot.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sara Nadeem <sara.nadeem@parcelly.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood trial + quick demo

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the snapshot. Happy to run a short walkthrough. Before we lock a time it would help to confirm a couple of preflight items so we can tailor the session and pre-provision a trial sandbox with appropriate capacity: 

1) Primary flow: is the pilot focused on embeddings for semantic search (vector store) + a lightweight chat layer that calls generation for suggested replies? Or are you expecting heavy-turn-by-turn generation for multi-step assisted workflows?
2) Volume: can you share expected monthly token counts or message counts for the pilot? If you're unsure, a ballpark (e.g., ~200k messages/mo or ~1M tokens/mo) is fine.
3) Concurrency: expected peak concurrent requests during office hours (e.g., 20–100 qps)? This impacts the GPU profile we provision.
4) Latency SLO: are 200–500ms median generation latencies acceptable, or do you need sub-200ms?
5) Timeline: you mentioned a Nov pilot start — is there a hard cutoff (license/board date) or flexible ramp?
6) Security: any must-haves for the trial (SSO, VPC egress, data retention rules)?

If you can drop answers inline I’ll loop in Ben (cc’d) to get a trial link and a couple of calendar options. We can also do a short pre-provision so the demo shows realistic throughput.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
[Attachment: trial-invite-link.txt]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Interest in Redwood trial + quick demo — can you own scheduling + sandbox prep?

Ben / Monica,
Forwarding Sara at Parcelly — they signed up via self-serve and want a quick walkthrough + a sandbox for a 4–6 week pilot. Sara sent a traffic snapshot (attached). Quick asks for scheduling: please propose short windows that cover APAC-friendly times; Sara is West Coast but the product team spans GMT too. Prefer to provide three varied options (morning PT, mid-day PT, and a slightly earlier PT which maps to late GMT). Suggested options I like: 
- Thu Oct 28, 09:30–10:00 PT (40–60min room if they want)
- Fri Oct 29, 13:00–13:30 PT
- Tue Nov 02, 08:00–08:30 PT

When you send the invite: include a short pre-demo checklist and ask them to confirm the six items in my previous reply (use case, volume, concurrency, latency, timeline, security). Also link the trial sandbox (attached).

Thanks — Markus

From: Sara Nadeem <sara.nadeem@parcelly.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood trial + quick demo

Hi Markus / Ben — thanks, and sorry for the quick turnaround. Answers inline below: 

> 1) Primary flow: is the pilot focused on embeddings for semantic search + chat?
We plan to use both: embeddings for retrieval-augmented retrieval (RAG) on our ticket corpus, plus a short chat layer that synthesizes suggested replies. Generation calls are generally single-turn (one prompt -> reply).

> 2) Volume: monthly tokens / messages?
Pilot (4–6 weeks): ~150k messages total across web + email (we estimate ~600k tokens for the pilot). If pilot succeeds, scaled production would be ~1.2M messages/mo.

> 3) Concurrency: expected peak qps?
Peak office hours we see spikes up to ~40 concurrent requests. Sustained weekday daytime closer to 8–12 qps.

> 4) Latency SLO: acceptable range?
We prefer median <300ms for short replies; 500ms ceiling is acceptable for longer syntheses.

> 5) Timeline: Nov pilot start?
We want to begin the pilot week of Nov 8 if possible — flexible by a week. No hard board deadline.

> 6) Security: must-haves?
SSO via SAML is a hard requirement for production, but for the pilot we can use an invite link + temporary credentials. Data residency: we prefer US-only processing if possible.

Confirming Nov 2, 08:00–08:30 PT would actually be a little tight for our product manager (GMT overlap is tricky). Can we instead lock Fri Oct 29 at 13:00 PT? That works for the majority of our team.

If that slot is open, please send a calendar invite and the trial sandbox URL. I attached the traffic snapshot again.

Best,
Sara
[Attachment: Parcelly_Traffic_Snapshot.xlsx]
